main_text.p: Aspiciunt equites læti: postióque furore, Vt glabrum uidere caput canamque senectam, Vix tandem inuiti lacrymas tenere cadentes, Ipsique e manibus gladij cecidere cruentis. Vnus torua ferox torquens Herennius ora, Degenerens quid statis? ait: simul ense superbo Colla secat, nec adhuc satiatum caede scelestum Adiunxisse iuuat sceleri scelus. Ergo disertis Ausas Antoni uitam signare tabellis Cadit & ipse manus. Morienti uidit ab alto Inuitus caelo Phoebus: piceaque refertur Nube caput texisse diu, fleuere cadentem Et flebunt Latia aeternum Graiaque camenae. Flexanimis uero Pitho (mirabile dictu) Sueta illi quondam, tum res, tu uerba loquenti Suggerere, & suaui conspergere nectare linguam, Vt patuit iugulus, moriente aufugit amico: Et terras, eheu, nunquam reditura, reliquit. Poppilius uolat interea, truncoque relicto, Antoni portat sauis[?] spectacula mensis.
main_text.head: NATALIA DOMINI.
Sylua III.
main_text.p: Peruigiles alius longa in conuiuia noctes, Gaudia consumptas aut in furtiua tenebras, In fami celebret captans ex carmine nomen: At tu sancta meis potius sacrata camœnis

page.notes: The large initial P of the last passage is joined to "eruigiles" as "Peruigiles". The word "sauis" in the penultimate verse is doubtful. The rule above the title is a printed rule, not text.
